_comment: The unlock ladder, tunable. Track index i on a shelf unlocks when ANY of these is true (i=0 is free on opening the game): visible seconds >= secsPer*i; calendar days played >= 1 + daysPer*i; sessions (60s+ page loads) >= sessionsBase + i; and, on a FAMILY shelf only, distinct games of that family opened >= 1 + breadthPer*i. Edit, then `node scripts/music_manifest.mjs` regenerates music-catalog.js with it. Stephen 2026-09-02: 'it should be easy to unlock most of these to start' and 'the more card games you try, the more you unlock'.
